svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Each gene family enters at tier 1. The first tier that fires assigns the category; the winning tier is recorded per family.

g.text: rgpA rgpB kgp · porK porL sov
term must be definitive to fire
Informative-name filter excludes UPF/DUF/hypothetical hits that cannot confirm or refute a call. Disagreements reviewed by hand.

svg.text: Ten categories cover every gene — GO and KEGG annotate under half the P. gingivalis genome, so enrichment analyses run on the full genome rather than an annotated subset.

g.text: mfa5 — A1 A2 B C D E
K2 · K5 · K7 — no complete genome

svg.text: All schemes rank hits by identity × coverage, never raw bitscore — a long low-identity reference cannot outscore a short exact match.

g.text: Six thin wrappers · each importable and each a console command
Installer fetches BLAST+, sets up venv

svg.text: Validation: 12 reference-typed genomes, every scheme returned the expected call; fimA independently confirmed by in-silico PCR with published typing primers.
